slides.title: Problem and research contribution
slides.speaker_notes: Assigned presenter: Rafay Ul Haq. Planned speaking: 60 seconds. FinBERT provides news sentiment, XGBoost classifies the feature vector, and TreeSHAP supplies model attributions. Explain the engineering contribution without claiming invention of these methods or established research novelty. An explanation can be numerically consistent without being useful or causal. The related-work chapter compares the research components and discusses the remaining novelty review. Research sources in that chapter include FinBERT arXiv:1908.10063 and TreeSHAP arXiv:1802.03888.

slides.title: Scope and acceptance checks
slides.speaker_notes: Assigned presenter: Ahmed Javaid. Planned speaking: 60 seconds. The four record collections preserve historical and fresh frozen/refit identities. There are 186 decisions in each evaluation collection, not independent experiments to sum as a single sample. The risk-dependent blend is a separate retrospective prototype and does not modify the classifier probabilities. No default questionnaire responses are supplied. Social inputs have not been integrated into the news-only core. Original Phi-3-mini inference and QLoRA training remain unmeasured.

slides.title: Explanation check and recovery
slides.speaker_notes: Assigned presenter: Soban Ahmad. Planned speaking: 45 seconds. An earlier verifier accepted facts from the payload even when the visible sentence contradicted them. The current verifier checks both independently. In the live demo, inject the labelled wrong probability of 1.00 percent. Explain that this deliberately corrupted text is a failure demonstration, not a forecast. The report sequence and state diagrams show rejection, fallback and invalidation after edits. Numerical consistency does not establish causal validity or human comprehension.

slides.title: Live demonstration
slides.speaker_notes: Shared demo: Rafay opens for 20 seconds, Soban Decision 40, Ahmed Evidence 40, Rafay Risk 60, Soban Explanation 80. Reserve four minutes for the live walkthrough. Open Overview and choose Open the decision walkthrough. Leave the default Fresh Alpaca frozen case on 2023-12-21. Decision shows Buy and its calibrated probabilities. On Evidence choose a technical feature and a news feature. Risk profile: the explicit cautious fictional example R=0 gives Hold, and the higher-tolerance example R=1 gives Sell in the separate comparator, while the classifier remains Buy. Clear the profile to demonstrate no assumed answers. On Explanation check choose Inject wrong probability, then Check explanation. Show candidate rejection and verified fallback. Edit the text and show that the old verdict disappears. Fourteen primary-UI widget tests pass, including calibration-diagnostic identity/refusal. The full 42-test scope includes 24 historical UI tests and 4 selectors and must not be described as 42 new-interface tests. The header correction restores 4.75 rem clearance and full-width navigation. The actual browser journey is reviewed; physical projector review and genuine rehearsal remain pending.

slides.title: Calibration and decision collapse
slides.speaker_notes: Assigned presenter: Soban Ahmad. Planned speaking: 55 seconds. These are fresh Alpaca revision-conservative results, not overwritten September metrics. The frozen and refit paths both reproduce actual model, calibration and native SHAP results. After excluding five unavailable labels, calibration has 181 rows. Frozen raw macro-F1 is 0.3182 and calibrated macro-F1 is 0.2238. Refit Brier changes from 0.7760 to 0.6078. The class-prior comparator uses calibration labels only, with Brier 0.60948945. The retained maps have Buy minimum 0.5344828, Hold maximum 0.25 and Sell maximum 0.3139535. Clipped interpolation stays inside these ranges. Common positive renormalization preserves argmax, so these maps force Buy for every raw vector. A separate native engine probe exactly replays 186 rows per mode and all 5,151 simplex inputs select Buy. Sources: evidence/calibration_global_bounds_20261013.json, evidence/calibration_bounds_native_probe_20261013.json and evidence/calibration_class_prior_audit_20261013.json. This applies only to the fresh maps. Do not tune held-out thresholds to manufacture varied decisions.

slides.title: Temporal leakage experiment
slides.speaker_notes: Assigned presenter: Ahmed Javaid. Planned speaking: 100 seconds. The fresh study executes six arms, two horizons and six folds. The centered Bollinger variant deliberately uses future information and is a leakage demonstration. Its five-session lift is plus 0.2104, with fold-bootstrap interval plus 0.1698 to plus 0.2421. It is not a valid trading strategy. The clean arm is below the training-distribution random comparator. The intervals summarize fold resampling, not guaranteed future returns. Preserve the negative finding. The source vintage and full chronological September reproduction remain separate limitations.

slides.title: Sentiment and teacher studies
slides.speaker_notes: Assigned presenter: Rafay Ul Haq. Planned speaking: 100 seconds. Both original publisher sentiment candidates run against unchanged AI references. CryptoBERT predicts only neutral. The 200 acquired MSFT posts yielded 117 usable references and 83 exclusions, frozen into 93 development and 24 held-out examples. These labels are not independently human validated. One held-out decision changes exact agreement by 4.17 percentage points. Do not infer NVDA transfer, profitability, significance or pretraining independence. The teacher prose is actual assistant output with deterministic factual JSON assembled from records. The exact serving revision is unavailable. Six examples do not establish adequate training data, student efficacy or user benefit.
